briefings.tldr: This briefing covers the passing of media visionary Ted Turner, a mixed earnings week for legacy media giants Disney, Paramount, and Warner Bros. Discovery, and the escalating "petty" legal and corporate drama between Elon Musk and OpenAI.

briefings.title: Reid Hoffman On The Case For AI Optimism
briefings.tldr: Reid Hoffman argues that AI represents a "Cognitive Industrial Revolution" where success is measured by technological frontier-building rather than short-term financials; while labor displacement in scripted roles is inevitable, the focus must shift to using AI to democratize essential services like healthcare and education.

briefings.tldr: Legendary venture capitalist Bill Gurley argues that extreme curiosity and high agency are the primary safeguards against AI displacement, while warning that the "institutionalization" of venture capital and "circular" accounting deals are distorting market health and excluding retail investors.

briefings.title: Scott Galloway: why tackling the 'crisis of masculinity' would also help close the gender gap
briefings.tldr: The "crisis of masculinity" is a systemic issue where young men are falling behind in education, economic viability, and mental health, yet Scott Galloway argues that lifting men up is entirely compatible with—and necessary for—the continued progress of women and Western society.
